how-to-take-good-meeting-notes.20: General-purpose chatbots can summarize a transcript you paste in, but they never join or record calls by themselves. Dedicated AI meeting assistants capture the call, transcribe it and produce notes automatically, which removes the copy-paste step.
how-to-take-good-meeting-notes.22: To take meeting notes quickly, write fragments not sentences, use shorthand, and skip anything already headed for a shared document or recording. Raw typing speed matters less than deciding what to leave out.
how-to-take-good-meeting-notes.25: If your company forbids recording, shared notes work well: appoint one note-taker and let colleagues add their own action items. For AI options in Teams, see [Teams AI note takers](https://lynkk.ai/blog/ai-note-taker-microsoft-teams).

how-to-take-good-meeting-notes.30: Avoid always handing notes to the most junior person, or to the same people out of habit. Note-taking is real work. Share it.
